title: Coastal Protection and Other Amendments Bill at Second Reading
what_it_is: A Bill at Second Reading, moved by the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment, to amend the Sewerage and Drainage Act and related laws to create a coastal protection framework, including PUB powers, landowner obligations, grants and enforcement.
why_it_matters: The Minister said sea levels may rise up to 1.15 metres by the end of this century and up to five metres with storm surges and high tides, and that around 30% of Singapore could be flooded by seawater. The Bill creates obligations for owners of Prescribed Places to put coastal protection measures in place by a stipulated date, with PUB coordinating and enforcing a continuous line of defence. It also provides for a capital grant and technical advice to support landowners.

key_points.point: The Bill is introduced principally to provide legislative and regulatory levers for coastal protection work.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: principally to introduce legislative and regulatory levers to undergird coastal protection work moving forward.

key_points.point: New coastal protection elements will be inserted into the Sewerage and Drainage Act, which will be renamed the Sewerage, Drainage and Coastal Protection Act.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: These new coastal protection elements will be introduced into the existing Sewerage and Drainage Act (SDA), which will be renamed the Sewerage, Drainage and Coastal Protection Act (SDCPA).

key_points.point: Sea levels may rise up to 1.15 metres by end-century and up to five metres with storm surges and high tides.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Singapore's Third National Climate Change Study (V3) projects that our sea levels may rise up to 1.15 metres by the end of this century, reaching up to five metres above today's mean sea level when coupled with storm surges and high tides.

key_points.point: Around 30% of Singapore could be flooded by seawater.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: It means that around 30% of Singapore could be flooded by seawater.

key_points.point: PUB was designated as Singapore's coastal protection agency in 2020 through amendments to the Public Utilities Act.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: In 2020, to prepare Singapore for this long-term endeavour, we amended the Public Utilities Act (PUA) to designate PUB, Singapore's national water agency, as our coastal protection agency.

key_points.point: The Bill gives PUB powers to determine and gazette the continuous line of defence as an Absolute Protection Boundary.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: The Bill will provide PUB with the powers to determine the location of this continuous line of defence and gazette this line as an Absolute Protection Boundary.

key_points.point: The Bill sets out four categories of Prescribed Places with corresponding coastal protection requirements.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: In relation to these Boundaries, the Bill sets out four categories of Prescribed Places, which would have corresponding requirements of coastal protection measures to be put in place.

key_points.point: Each landowner must ensure a coastal protection measure for the Prescribed Place by a stipulated date.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Under the new section 30E of the Bill, each landowner must ensure that there is a coastal protection measure for the Prescribed Place by a stipulated date.

key_points.point: Owners include the Government, Statutory Boards and lessees with leases longer than three years.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: These owners include the Government, Statutory Boards, as well as lessees with leases longer than three years.

key_points.point: The Government and Statutory Boards own about 70% of the coastline and will implement the majority of coastal protection measures.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: The majority of the coastal protection measures will be implemented by the Government and Statutory Boards as they own about 70% of the coastline.

key_points.point: A capital grant will cover studies, services diversion and construction necessary for coastal protection measures.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: First, we will provide a capital grant. The grant will cover the cost of studies, services diversion, as well as the construction necessary to implement coastal protection measures.

key_points.point: PUB will offer technical advice and consultations to landowners.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Second, we will offer technical advice and consultations to landowners.

key_points.point: Section 30G requires landowners to connect their coastal protection measures with adjacent neighbours.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Section 30G requires landowners to connect their coastal protection measures with their adjacent neighbours.

key_points.point: Landowners must seek PUB approval before undertaking or altering coastal protection works.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: before undertaking coastal protection works, or before altering existing coastal protection measures

key_points.point: The coastal protection measures and Safety Corridor will be delineated in the Coastal Protection Interpretation Plan under section 30C.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: The coastal protection measures and the Safety Corridor will be delineated in the Coastal Protection Interpretation Plan, or Interpretation Plan, under section 30C.

key_points.point: Section 30I requires landowners to maintain, repair, inspect and monitor their measures.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Section 30I requires landowners to maintain, repair, inspect and monitor their measures.

key_points.point: Section 30K allows regulations to require landowners with deployable barriers to deploy them before an imminent coastal flooding event.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: For landowners with deployable barriers, section 30K states that regulations may require these landowners to deploy the barriers before an imminent coastal flooding event, as required by PUB.

key_points.point: Section 30L requires landowners in transiently floodable areas to prepare a flood response plan and conduct drills.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: landowners of premises within the areas will be required under section 30L to prepare a flood response plan and periodically conduct drills based on the flood response plan.

key_points.point: PUB will endeavour to inform landowners of their obligations about 10 years ahead of expected completion.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: PUB will endeavour to inform them of their obligations about 10 years ahead of the expected completion date.

key_points.point: Landowners will have at least five years from the Second Notification to implement their measures.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Landowners will have at least five years from the Second Notification to implement their measures.

key_points.point: PUB aims to publish the Coastal Protection Code of Practice later this year, ahead of First Notifications.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: PUB aims to do so later this year, ahead of issuing the First Notifications.

key_points.point: The Bill amends section 43 of the SDA to give PUB emergency powers of entry.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: The Bill will amend section 43 of the SDA to provide PUB with emergency powers of entry, if, for example, the continuous line of defence is not yet complete due to delays, or a landowner cannot be contacted to deploy the coastal protection measure.

key_points.point: Forced entry will only be used judiciously and only where there is an imminent coastal flooding event.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: This power of forced entry will only be used judiciously, and only where there is an imminent coastal flooding event.

key_points.point: The Bill also amends the Significant Infrastructure Government Loan Act 2021 to adopt the new definition of coastal management.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: the Bill amends the Significant Infrastructure Government Loan Act 2021 to adopt the new definition of “coastal management” inserted in the PUA by the Bill

key_points.point: The proposed SDA amendments will commence this year.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: The proposed amendments to the SDA which I mentioned, will commence this year.

key_points.point: Affected landowners' legal obligations will only begin closer to the early 2030s after the boundaries are gazetted.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: affected landowners’ legal obligations will only begin taking effect closer to early 2030s, after the Absolute Protection Boundaries and Protection Boundaries are gazetted.

key_points.point: Ms Poh Li San asked the Minister to consider a centralised approach for design and construction of all coastal protection measures.
key_points.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
key_points.quote: I ask the Minister to consider a centralised approach towards the design and construction of all coastal protection measures to ensure the most robust outcomes.

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong asked for the number or ratio of non-Government entities or non-Government-linked corporations among owners and lessees.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
key_points.quote: I would also like to ask the Minister to give us an indication of, among the non-state entities-related owners or lessees, the number or ratio of the non-Government entities or non-Government-linked corporations who are owners and lessees, be they individuals, Management Corporations Strata Title (MCSTs), clubs or other non-business or non-state entities.

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong said it would be a significant financial burden for a company with less than 10 or 15 years left on its lease to invest in multimillion-dollar seawalls.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
key_points.quote: It would be a significant financial burden to ask a company with only or less than 10 or even 15 years left on their lease to invest in multimillion-dollar seawalls.

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong asked whether there will be tiered subsidies for local SMEs.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
key_points.quote: Will there be tiered subsidies, specifically for local SMEs who may lack the cash reserve for major Government-linked Corporations and MNCs?

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong asked whether the Government will require performance bonds from private lessees.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
key_points.quote: Will the Government require performance bonds from private lessees to ensure funds are available to complete the project if the state or another state-appointed entity is required to complete the works required?

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong asked whether PUB has step-in rights to take over lagging projects and charge costs back before the 10-year window expires.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
key_points.quote: Does the PUB have step-in rights to take over any lagging project and charge the cost back to the owner before the 10-year window expires?

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong asked the Government to consider tabling an annual coastal resilience report on Coastal and Flood Protection Fund disbursements and progress.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
key_points.quote: I hope the Government will consider tabling an annual coastal resilience report detailing Coastal and Flood Protection Fund disbursements and progress across both public and private sectors.

key_points.point: Ms Hany Soh asked how extensive PUB's consultations were with the roughly 30% private owners or lessors of the coastal line.
key_points.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
key_points.quote: how extensive were its consultations with the roughly 30% of the private owners or lessors of our Singapore coastal line?

key_points.point: Ms Hany Soh suggested PUB consider an opt-in for private owners or lessors to use economies of scale for implementation or installation of measures.
key_points.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
key_points.quote: at least for the implementation or installation of the Costal Protection Measures for private owners or lessors instead of requiring them to procure the same from scratch.

key_points.point: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre asked whether the Code of Practice will actively incentivise developers and landowners to think about what transiently floodable spaces could be for the 99% of the time they are dry.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: Will the Code of Practice merely dictate technical details, like the height of sea walls and the specifications of pumps, or will it actively incentivise developers and landowners to think about what these spaces could be for the 99% of the time that they are dry?

key_points.point: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre asked whether there is a deliberate strategy to position Singapore as the global centre of excellence for tropical coastal resilience.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: I would ask the Minister if there is a deliberate strategy to position Singapore as the global centre of excellence for tropical coastal resilience

key_points.point: Ms Cassandra Lee invited the Government to consider statutory guidance on the transfer of obligations.
key_points.speaker: Ms Cassandra Lee
key_points.quote: May I invite the Government to consider statutory guidance on the transfer of obligations

key_points.point: Ms Cassandra Lee asked whether the Government will consider developing a vetted panel of contractors or an accreditation scheme for private sector use.
key_points.speaker: Ms Cassandra Lee
key_points.quote: Will the Government consider developing a vetted panel of contractors or an accreditation scheme for private sector use?

key_points.point: Ms Cassandra Lee asked whether affected landowners and lessees will be required to undertake environmental impact assessments.
key_points.speaker: Ms Cassandra Lee
key_points.quote: I ask if the Government will require affected landowners and lessees to undertake environmental impact assessments

key_points.point: Ms Lee Hui Ying asked whether the Code of conduct will provide sufficient guidance to promote consistent implementation between landowners.
key_points.speaker: Ms Lee Hui Ying
key_points.quote: Will the Code of conduct provide sufficient guidance to promote consistent implementation between landowners?

key_points.point: Ms Lee Hui Ying asked whether PUB will set guidelines or conditions for handover of technical knowledge to new landowners or lessees.
key_points.speaker: Ms Lee Hui Ying
key_points.quote: Will PUB set guidelines or conditions for the handover of technical knowledge to new landowners or lessees to preserve critical technical knowledge of privately-built coastal defences during transitions?

key_points.point: Ms Lee Hui Ying asked whether the Government has assessed how the Bill will affect business competitiveness for coastal landowners.
key_points.speaker: Ms Lee Hui Ying
key_points.quote: Has the Government assessed how this Bill will affect business competitiveness for our coastal landowners?

key_points.point: The Government will not recover the cost of centralised coastal protection measures from landowners protected by them.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We will not be recovering the cost of these measures from the landowners, just like how we are not imposing any costs on inland landowners.

key_points.point: Absolute Protection Boundaries will be gazetted in Subsidiary Legislation and published in the Coastal Protection Interpretation Plan, discoverable during legal conveyancing.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We will gazette the Absolute Protection Boundaries in Subsidiary Legislation and publish it in the Coastal Protection Interpretation Plan, which would be discoverable during legal conveyancing.

key_points.point: Ahead of formal gazetting, PUB will work towards publishing indicative locations of the boundaries in the public domain.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: In addition, ahead of the formal gazetting, PUB will work towards publishing the indicative locations of the Absolute Protection Boundaries and the Protection Boundaries in the public domain, so that prospective lessees and landowners will be aware of their potential obligations.

key_points.point: On transfer of ownership, liability transfer is no different from when property changes hands today.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: When there is a transfer of ownership, the transfer of liability is no different from when property changes hands today.

key_points.point: The previous landowner must engage a Qualified Person to certify the structure is up to standard before PUB approves it as a coastal protection measure.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: the previous landowner would have had to engage a Qualified Person to certify that the structure is up to standard, before PUB approves it as a coastal protection measure.

key_points.point: If co-ownership arises, co-owners will each be responsible for coastal protection obligations.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: However, should this scenario arise, co-owners will each be responsible for coastal protection obligations.

key_points.point: Landowners must submit relevant reports and drawings, including as-built drawings and maintenance reports, to PUB.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Under the Bill, landowners will need to submit relevant reports and drawings, including as-built drawings and maintenance reports, to PUB.

key_points.point: Section 30G allows PUB to provide as-built drawings or plans of the neighbouring plot to a landowner if necessary to ensure connection.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Section 30G allows PUB to provide as-built drawings or plans of the neighbouring plot to a landowner, if necessary, to ensure that the connection is effected.

key_points.point: The Code of Practice will be published later this year and set baseline planning, design, operation and maintenance requirements.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: This Code of Practice will be published later this year. It will set out the baseline planning, design, operation and maintenance requirements for landowners' compliance.

key_points.point: PUB has power under sections 41 and 44 to step in, undertake maintenance and repair works, and recover costs from the landowner.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: First, PUB has power under sections 41 and 44 to step in and undertake maintenance and repair works to ensure the functionality of the continuous line of defence and to recover the cost as necessary from the landowner subsequently.

key_points.point: PUB officers must seek senior management approval before forced entry.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: When activating such powers of forced entry, PUB officers will be required to seek PUB senior management's approval before proceeding with forced entry into these premises.

key_points.point: Grant details are still being worked out and more information will be released when ready.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We are still working out the grant details, and more information will be released when ready.

key_points.point: The grant is intended to fund necessary costs of putting in place the coastal protection measure.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: The intent of the grant is to fund the necessary costs of putting in place the coastal protection measure.

key_points.point: PUB is considering reimbursing the landowner in tranches to monitor progress of works.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We are considering reimbursing the landowner in tranches. This would allow us to monitor the progress of works.

key_points.point: If landownership changes before completion, the new landowner can use the previous plans or submit fresh plans to PUB for approval.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Should there be a change in landownership before the completion date, the new landowner has the option of using the previous set of plans or submitting a fresh set of plans to PUB for approval.

key_points.point: PUB currently has no plans to maintain a list of pre-approved contractors.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: PUB currently does not have any plans to maintain a list of pre-approved contractors.

key_points.point: PUB will work with professional bodies and industry associations to run training courses and accreditation for flood protection managers.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: To ensure the flood protection managers are well positioned for their roles, we will work with professional bodies and industry associations to run training courses and accreditation.

key_points.point: If there is potentially significant environmental impact, agencies will require an environmental study and mitigation measures.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: If there is potentially significant environmental impact, agencies will require an environmental study to assess the full impact of the works and develop more extensive mitigation measures.

key_points.point: There is ongoing research to assess hybrid nature-based solutions for coastal protection.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: As part of the Coastal Protection and Flood Management Research Programme, there is ongoing research to assess the efficacy of hybrid nature-based solutions for coastal protection.

key_points.point: Nature-based solutions will be shared in future editions of the Code of Practice where applicable.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Where applicable, these nature-based solutions will be shared in future editions of the Code of Practice.

key_points.point: A Flood Resilient Developments Guidebook will be published.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: we are going to publish a guidebook that is called the Flood Resilient Developments Guidebook, that is developed through an Alliance for Action on how we can incorporate some of these design elements.

key_points.point: The Bill lays the foundation for a continuous line of defence for the next 50, 100 years and more.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: This Bill lays the foundation to ensure a continuous line of defence that will protect Singapore against sea level rise for the next 50, 100 years and more.

key_points.point: Responsibility for a compromised measure lies with the landowner that executed the work.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: The first question on responsibility, it will have to lie with the landowner that has executed the work.

key_points.point: A later landowner joining to an existing measure is responsible for ensuring the connection is water-tight.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: If you are the later one that is joining to one that is already been built, it is your responsibility to ensure that there is connection and that the connection is water-tight.

key_points.point: PUB is investing in forecasting and hopes to forecast days in advance.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We are investing a lot into the ability to forecast. And we hope that we are able to forecast days in advance.

key_points.point: If PUB cannot contact a landowner by a certain time, it may enter premises to erect measures after seeking senior management approval.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: if they are unable to contact the landowner by a certain time and they have to access, they have no alternative except to enter the premises to erect some of these measures, then they have to seek the approval from their senior management and they will have enough time to erect temporary measures and interim measures.

key_points.point: PUB places emphasis on engaging the local community.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We place a lot of emphasis on engaging the community, the local community.

key_points.point: Boundary lines were moved back in some cases to allow transient flooding at Sungei Buloh after long discussions.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: At the same time, we have also moved back the boundary lines in some cases, allowing some transient flooding to occur at Sungei Buloh, really after having long discussions.

not_said: How will the capital grant be sized, disbursed and monitored, and when will the details be released?
How many affected private lessees have remaining lease terms of less than 10 years?
Will performance bonds or mandatory construction milestones be required for private lessees?
How will liability for latent defects at the interface between adjoining coastal protection measures be allocated?
Will PUB maintain a list of pre-approved contractors or an accreditation scheme for private-sector use?
How will environmental impact assessments apply to specific coastal protection works?
How will the Code of Practice incentivise nature-based solutions?
How will the $5 billion Coastal and Flood Protection Fund be prioritised and split between public and private expenditure?
Will an annual coastal resilience report be tabled?
How will flood protection manager training and certification be delivered?
How will the timing of site-specific studies be publicised and how can citizen scientists participate?
How will the Government handle a lessee that fails to complete construction before giving up the lease?
Will lease extensions be tied to coastal protection investments?
How will the public-private split in expenditure be determined?
